user.title: Raum-Dashboard
user.description: Sets up the “Räume” page in the sidebar. No settings needed.

init.title: Appearance
init.description: Applies after the next reload of the “Räume” page.

data.himmel_nach_zeit: Light and sky by time of day and weather

data_description.moebel_durchsichtig: 0 % = fully visible, 100 % = almost invisible. Walls and floors stay.
data_description.outlines_leuchten: 0 % = off. Higher values make the edges glow and need a bit more rendering power.
data_description.temperatur_farben: Each room floor turns blue when colder and orange when warmer, if a temperature sensor is placed there as a point.
data_description.himmel_nach_zeit: Sun position from sun.sun, weather from the first weather entity. Without them the clock is used.
